name: rein-man
description: Rein Man — The Intelligence Behind the Odds.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply rein-man --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply rein-man --remote -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
